sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> 8020 Abyssal Mask -> passives[0] 'Unmake' (unique: true), branches[0]
sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.reading: Binary debuff state ('become cursed'), applied by the HOLDER to the holder's ENEMIES; the amplifier is +12% and is scoped to MAGIC damage only, but is open to every damage source (holder or allies).

sources_quoted.text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.reading: +7% amplifier, NOT damage-type scoped (all damage), so it is the only one of the two amps that legitimately touches physical/true events.

sources_quoted.text: Dealing {{as|magic damage}} to an enemy champion with a champion ability applies a stack of ''Vile Decay'' ... Each stack inflicts {{as|{{fd|7.5}}% magic resistance reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|mr}} at 4 stacks.
sources_quoted.reading: The third item the scenario name plausibly refers to ('curse'). It changes MR, not a flat damage multiplier; math-foundations calls out the 'Vile Decay ramp' under _ability_dot_tick_events.

sources_quoted.text: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... post = raw * m(R)
sources_quoted.reading: Mitigation is a per-event multiplicative factor, so any amplifier that is switched on/off shows up as an exact ratio between the old and new leaf values.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json full sweep for the literal '12%' in passive/active branch text
sources_quoted.text: Only 8020 Abyssal Mask carries a 12% damage amplifier (Warmog/Knight's Vow/Shojin/Immortal Path/Prowler's Claw/Gambler's Blade 12%-hits are health regen, damage redirect, haste, 4% amp, max-health damage and proc chance respectively). data/runes.json contains no 12% amplifier.
sources_quoted.reading: In the current cache the factor 1.12 is uniquely attributable to Abyssal Mask's Unmake curse.

step_1_isolate_the_delta.closure_check: 197.5 x 1.12 = 221.200 exactly at the leaf's 1-decimal precision (tolerance band [221.15,221.25]/[197.45,197.55] = 1.11946..1.12053, so the true ratio is 1.1200 +/- 0.0005)
step_1_isolate_the_delta.conclusion: The change is exactly one Abyssal Mask curse factor (x1.12) applied to this event in the old value and not in the new one. No other cached item or rune supplies a 1.12 multiplier.

step_2_rule_out_alternative_generators_o.additive_vs_multiplicative_amp_compositi: Mandate 7% + Abyssal 12% additive (1.19) vs multiplicative (1.07 x 1.12 = 1.1984) differ by only 1.0071x, not 1.12 - excluded.
step_2_rule_out_alternative_generators_o.vile_decay_MR_reduction: A Bloodletter's stack change would move mitigation by (100+R_new)/(100+R_old). Hitting 1.1200 +/- 0.0005 requires a tuned magic resistance: 4->0 stacks needs R=55.6, 4->1 needs R=85.1, 3->0 needs R=90.9, and no round MR value lands inside the tolerance for the 4->0 case. A ratio that is exact for ANY base (a flat amplifier) is the parsimonious explanation; an MR-ramp explanation requires a coincidence.
step_2_rule_out_alternative_generators_o.abyssal_45_MR_stat: A change in the target's own MR would also have to be tuned to hit 1.1200 exactly; excluded on the same grounds.

step_3_apply_the_wiki_rule.rule_A_damage_type: The curse amplifies MAGIC damage only ('receive 12% increased magic damage'). It must not multiply a physical or true damage event. Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable ('damage they take from all sources by 7%') is the only unscoped amp in this scenario.
step_3_apply_the_wiki_rule.rule_B_who_is_cursed: The curse is applied by the holder to the holder's ENEMIES. An Abyssal Mask carried by the target's own team never amplifies damage that target receives, and the curse never amplifies damage dealt BY the cursed champion.
step_3_apply_the_wiki_rule.rule_C_binary_state: 'become cursed' plus the passive's unique: true flag describe a binary debuff, not a stacking one - a roster with more than one Abyssal Mask still yields a single x1.12, never x1.12^2.

step_4_reconstruction.pre_amp_mitigated_damage: If Mandate's Vulnerable applies to this event, D0 = 197.5 / 1.07 = 184.58; the new leaf is D0 x 1.07 = 197.5 and the old leaf is D0 x 1.07 x 1.12 = 221.2.
step_4_reconstruction.double_curse_reading: Alternatively the new leaf already carries one legitimate curse (base 197.5/1.12 = 176.34) and the old leaf carried it twice (176.34 x 1.12^2 = 221.2).
step_4_reconstruction.either_way: The old value contains one Abyssal curse factor that at least one of rules A/B/C forbids; the new value contains at most one, which is the maximum the wiki text permits for a single cursed target.

reasoning_for_verdict: The delta is a clean, base-independent x1.12 - i.e. an amplifier toggle, not a mitigation or scaling change.

All three wiki-derived constraints on the curse (magic-only scoping, holder-relative targeting, binary non-stacking state) can only ever REMOVE a 1.12 factor from a leaf; none of them can require a second one. The old value is the only one of the two that can hold a forbidden factor.

The scenario stacks amplifiers from items that are scoped differently (Mandate: all damage; Abyssal: magic only; Bloodletter's: MR shred on magic damage). A roster fight mixes damage types across participants, so applying the magic-scoped curse uniformly to every pair event is the natural defect this scenario is built to expose - and it produces exactly a 1/1.12 correction on the non-magic events while leaving the magic ones untouched.

A single mid-sequence event (index 8) moving is consistent with selective per-event correction, not with the curse being deleted engine-wide (which would have scaled every event of this pair by the same factor).
falsification_condition: This verdict flips to old_value_correct only if ALL of the following hold in the scenario definition (which this oracle deliberately did not read): exactly one Abyssal Mask exists in the fight, it is held by the main attacker or one of the attacker's allies (never by the target's team), the target of event 8 is that holder's enemy, and event 8 carries MAGIC damage. In that configuration the wiki text ('12% increased magic damage from all sources') requires the x1.12 and 221.2 would be right. Any single one of those conditions failing makes 197.5 right.
